workflow.description: Repository path of the workflow that produced the object.
workflow.title: Workflow

commit.description: Exact source-control commit used for the derivation when available.
commit.title: Commit

seed.description: Recorded random seed, including zero for deterministic methods that do not draw random values.
seed.title: Seed

algorithm.description: Short name of the selection or generation method.
algorithm.title: Algorithm

parameters.description: Resolved inputs that affect the generated files.
parameters.title: Parameters

versions.description: Software and data versions needed to interpret the derivation.
versions.title: Versions

path.description: Normalized path inside the dataset directory.
path.title: Path

tier.description: Size or function class used for retrieval and validation.
tier.title: Tier

role.description: File purpose used by the validator and command line tools.
role.title: Role

sample_id.description: Sample linked to this file when the file is sample-specific.
sample_id.title: Sample Id

media_type.description: Internet media type for the file content.
media_type.title: Media Type

url.description: Optional public download URL for remotely retrieved content.
url.title: Url

name.description: Supported preservation measure recomputed by validation.
name.title: Name

minimum.description: Inclusive pass threshold for the metric.
minimum.title: Minimum

definition.description: Human-readable feature universe, calculation and preferred direction.
definition.title: Definition

genome.description: Genome assembly used for the source quantification.
genome.title: Genome

annotation.description: Gene annotation release used for the source quantification.
annotation.title: Annotation

namespace.description: Identifier system used in the count matrix.
namespace.title: Namespace

compatibility.description: Result of checking matrix identifiers against the declared annotation.
compatibility.title: Compatibility

status.description: Redistribution decision under the documented intake policy.
status.title: Status

license.description: Licence name or the reason redistribution remains restricted.
license.title: License

evidence.description: Source and reasoning that support the rights decision.
evidence.title: Evidence

checked.description: Date when the rights evidence was reviewed.
checked.title: Checked

sample_id.description: Stable sample or run label in the order used by the count matrix.
sample_id.title: Sample Id

condition.description: Biological group used by the declared comparison.
condition.title: Condition

replicate.description: One-based replicate number within the relevant design group.
replicate.title: Replicate

batch.description: Blocking or batch value used by the declared model.
batch.title: Batch

strandedness.description: Library strandedness reported by the source, or unknown when the archive does not state it.
strandedness.title: Strandedness

repository.description: Archive or synthetic generator that supplied the object.
repository.title: Repository

accession.description: Stable source accession or fixture identifier.
accession.title: Accession

url.description: Public HTTPS page for the source record or generator.
url.title: Url

citation.description: Citation that a user should retain when reusing this object.
citation.title: Citation

retrieved.description: Date when the source material was retrieved or generated.
retrieved.title: Retrieved

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original source file when that file can be redistributed.
sha256.title: Sha256

profile.description: Path to the expected validation profile inside the dataset directory.
profile.title: Profile

baseline_version.description: Version label for the expected values and calculation rules.
baseline_version.title: Baseline Version

metrics.description: Quantitative minimums that every validated object must meet.
metrics.title: Metrics

schema_version.description: Version of the OpenOmicsBench dataset contract.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

id.description: Stable collection identifier used by the command line interface.
id.title: Id

title.description: Specific title that distinguishes this comparison from other objects.
title.title: Title

release.description: First project release that carries this manifest state.
release.title: Release

assay.description: Assay family represented by the object.
assay.title: Assay

kind.description: Whether the object comes from a biological source or a software fixture.
kind.title: Kind

archetype.description: Short description of the experimental design exercised by the object.
archetype.title: Archetype

organism.description: Scientific organism name, or synthetic for a generated fixture.
organism.title: Organism

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomy identifier for a biological object.
taxon_id.title: Taxon Id

rights.description: Dated redistribution decision and supporting evidence.

reference.description: Genome, annotation and identifier compatibility record.

samples.description: Ordered experimental design matching the matrix columns or read files.
samples.title: Samples

derivation.description: Workflow, code revision and resolved parameters used to create the object.

files.description: Complete declared inventory for the dataset directory.
files.title: Files

validation.description: Expected-result profile for a validated object, or null when validation does not apply.

limitations.description: Known constraints that affect interpretation or reuse.
limitations.title: Limitations
